scope: official PhysicsNeMo FNO train-only dynamic-action augmentation; no PPO or control claim
model: physicsnemo.models.fno.FNO unchanged from full40 free-AR H20

data.dataloader_reason: official synchronous iterator; avoids verified TensorDict process-global device-recorder race in threaded host prefetch
data.dynamic_validation: unchanged b01/b05 dynamic6 after training only

training_variants.checkpoint_selection: lowest unchanged validation H100 rollout score; never frozen and never dynamic6 waveform selection
training_variants.rule: continue at the selected parent's training horizon; do not downgrade an H50 parent to H20

parent_selection.rule: at launch choose the best already-completed A/B epoch under the same validation10 H100 protocol
parent_selection.required_input: explicit completed epoch directory (basename best forbidden) containing exactly one matching FNO.0.E.mdlus and checkpoint.0.E.pt pair
parent_selection.launch_action: copy both files into run/immutable_parent, verify SHA-256, chmod read-only, and train only from that copy

post_training_gates: unchanged validation10 H1/H10/H50/H100 including H100 versus persistence
unchanged dynamic6 validation-only H1/H10/H50/H100 and action-difference gates
no PPO authorization unless all existing formal gates pass
final physical benefit requires paired long-window real CFD
post_evaluation_runtime: dynamic6 uses independently resource-probed batch size 8, allocator fraction 0.12, stride 1
